# `skn` command reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:generate` in packages/cli. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every section below is the output of `skn <command> --help`. For a guided
walkthrough, see the [quickstart](../packages/cli/README.md#quickstart).

## `skn`

```text
skn 0.1.0: command-line tool for the Soroban Keeper Network

Usage:
  skn <group> [command] [flags]

Command groups:
  config   init | show: manage the config file and named profiles
  task     register | cancel | expire | increase-reward | extend-deadline (show, list, claim, execute: not yet)
  keeper   balance | withdraw | stake | unbond | withdraw-stake | unbonding
  admin    pause | unpause | set-fee-bps | set-min-reward | set-min-stake | set-dispute-window | sweep-fees
  batch    register: batch task registration from JSON or CSV
  deploy   registry | treasury | all: upload WASM, deploy and initialize contracts
  events   watch contract events (not implemented yet)
  inspect  [summary | version]: print protocol state and SDK compatibility

Global flags (accepted by every command):
  --profile <name>             named profile from the config file
  --network <name>             testnet, futurenet or mainnet (default: profile's, else testnet)
  --rpc-url <url>              override the preset's RPC URL
  --contract-id <id>           keeper-registry contract ID
  --treasury-contract-id <id>  treasury contract ID
  --key-file <path>            read the signing key from a file (must not be readable by others)
  --identity <name>            read the signing key from a Stellar CLI identity
  --confirm-mainnet            required to send a transaction on mainnet
  --json                       print machine-readable JSON

Signing key precedence: --key-file, then --identity, then SKN_SECRET_KEY.
Config file: SKN_CONFIG, or ~/.config/skn/skn.config.json.

Exit codes:
  0 success     1 internal error   2 usage error
  3 RPC error   4 contract error   5 not found
```

## `skn task register`

```text
skn task register: Register a task and escrow its reward

Usage:
  skn task register --type <name> --reward <stroops> --deadline <time> --ttl-ledgers <n> --lock-ledgers <n> [--calldata <hex>] [--verifier <address>]

Command flags:
  --type <name>         task type name or numeric discriminant (required)
  --reward <stroops>    reward paid to the keeper (required)
  --deadline <time>     Unix seconds or an ISO 8601 time such as 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z (required)
  --ttl-ledgers <n>     task time to live in ledgers (required)
  --lock-ledgers <n>    claim lock duration in ledgers (required)
  --calldata <hex>      opaque bytes handed to the keeper's executor
  --verifier <address>  optional verifier contract address

Global flags (accepted by every command):
  --profile <name>             named profile from the config file
  --network <name>             testnet, futurenet or mainnet (default: profile's, else testnet)
  --rpc-url <url>              override the preset's RPC URL
  --contract-id <id>           keeper-registry contract ID
  --treasury-contract-id <id>  treasury contract ID
  --key-file <path>            read the signing key from a file (must not be readable by others)
  --identity <name>            read the signing key from a Stellar CLI identity
  --confirm-mainnet            required to send a transaction on mainnet
  --json                       print machine-readable JSON

Notes:
  - The signing key is the task owner. The command prints the task's state as read back from the registry.
```

## `skn batch register`

```text
skn batch register: Register tasks from a JSON or CSV file

Usage:
  skn batch register <file> [--dry-run]

Command flags:
  --dry-run         validate and preview without submitting
  --file <path>     task file as a flag instead of a positional argument
  --from <path>     alias for --file, kept for compatibility
  --buffer-bps <n>  safety margin added to the reward budget (0 to 10000)

Global flags (accepted by every command):
  --profile <name>             named profile from the config file
  --network <name>             testnet, futurenet or mainnet (default: profile's, else testnet)
  --rpc-url <url>              override the preset's RPC URL
  --contract-id <id>           keeper-registry contract ID
  --treasury-contract-id <id>  treasury contract ID
  --key-file <path>            read the signing key from a file (must not be readable by others)
  --identity <name>            read the signing key from a Stellar CLI identity
  --confirm-mainnet            required to send a transaction on mainnet
  --json                       print machine-readable JSON

Notes:
  - The file is validated locally, then registrations are chunked by the contract's max_batch_size.
```

## `skn deploy`

```text
skn deploy: Upload, deploy and initialize the contracts

Usage:
  skn deploy [registry|treasury|all] [flags]

Command flags:
  --wasm <path>             WASM path used for both contracts
  --registry-wasm <path>    registry WASM path
  --treasury-wasm <path>    treasury WASM path
  --admin <address>         initial registry admin
  --reward-token <address>  reward token contract ID
  --fee-bps <n>             initial protocol fee
  --yes                     approve the change without an interactive prompt

Global flags (accepted by every command):
  --profile <name>             named profile from the config file
  --network <name>             testnet, futurenet or mainnet (default: profile's, else testnet)
  --rpc-url <url>              override the preset's RPC URL
  --contract-id <id>           keeper-registry contract ID
  --treasury-contract-id <id>  treasury contract ID
  --key-file <path>            read the signing key from a file (must not be readable by others)
  --identity <name>            read the signing key from a Stellar CLI identity
  --confirm-mainnet            required to send a transaction on mainnet
  --json                       print machine-readable JSON

Notes:
  - Every parameter is shown before submission. Mainnet also needs --confirm-mainnet.
```

```text
  --confirm-mainnet            required to send a transaction on mainnet
  --json                       print machine-readable JSON

Notes:
  - This group is reserved; no events command is implemented on this revision.
```

## `skn inspect`

```text
skn inspect: Print protocol state and SDK compatibility

Usage:
  skn inspect [summary|version] [flags]

Global flags (accepted by every command):
  --profile <name>             named profile from the config file
  --network <name>             testnet, futurenet or mainnet (default: profile's, else testnet)
  --rpc-url <url>              override the preset's RPC URL
  --contract-id <id>           keeper-registry contract ID
  --treasury-contract-id <id>  treasury contract ID
  --key-file <path>            read the signing key from a file (must not be readable by others)
  --identity <name>            read the signing key from a Stellar CLI identity
  --confirm-mainnet            required to send a transaction on mainnet
  --json                       print machine-readable JSON

Notes:
  - Read-only: every value comes from a simulated contract view.
```
